gloss: rookie of the year; best newcomer

definitions.gloss: rookie of the year; best newcomer
definitions.explanation: An award given to the most outstanding first-year player or newcomer in a sport, league, or other competitive field.

examples.japanese: {新人王|しんじんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He won the rookie of the year award.

examples.japanese: {新人王|しんじんおう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最有力|さいゆうりょく}→最有力：26230_saiyuuryoku⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He is said to be the strongest candidate for rookie of the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロ{野球|やきゅう}→プロ野球：08837_puroyakyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新人王|しんじんおう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧セ・リーグ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧パ・リーグ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: One rookie of the year is selected from each of the Central and Pacific Leagues in professional baseball.

notes:
USAGE:
Award commonly given in professional sports (baseball, soccer, sumo, boxing) and sometimes in entertainment or business. In Japanese professional baseball, it is formally called the ⟦{最優秀|さいゆうしゅう}→最優秀：28237_saiyuushuu⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧ award.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新人王|しんじんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to win the rookie award)
- {新人王|しんじんおう}⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧ (rookie of the year candidate)
- {新人王|しんじんおう}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧ (race for the rookie award)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{得点王|とくてんおう}→得点王：18555_tokutenou⟧: top scorer — the highest-scoring player in a league
